episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Detectives Leo and Bella investigate a heist that doesn't seem to make much sense. As more contradictory clues come in, the sparky banter between them belies a greater attraction.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Juggling lies, disposing of evidence and bribing an informant, Leo battles with his dangerous double life - and Carter and Dylan fear his feelings for Bella could destroy them all.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: When Hubble's body is pulled from the canal, Leo knows that he, Carter and Dylan must frame someone else for the murder, and set up a drug dealer. Meanwhile, Pascal seeks revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Leo and Carter explode into action when they discover that Dylan and Sophia have run off. As the chemistry between Leo and Bella intensifies, he is forced to make a huge decision.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A shock murder leaves Leo reeling, Dylan acting out, and Lucas questioning his loyalties. Bella's intuition leads her closer to uncovering that one of the gang is a police officer.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: When Bella's investigation leads her to Hackney Marshes - confirming her suspicions - she asks Leo for help. Can he find a way out while ensuring Bella doesn't come to harm?
